posts.title: When Earth Was Middle Earth: Speculations on the Hominins of the Middle Stone Age (Part 2)
posts.description: Last post , I ran out of steam after describing only two of the five species in my book: Homo naledi , or “treefolk” and Homo erectus , or “firstfolk”. This post, I’ll finish the series off with Homo longi or “dragonfolk”, more commonly known as Denisovans, Homo neanderthalensis or “tidefolk”, commonly known as Neanderthals, and Homo sapiens , or “kinfolk”. posts.title: Breastfeeding: An Evolutionary History
posts.description: It’s been awhile since my last post - a lot of life has happened in the interim, namely having a baby. Now that baby is three months old, I’ve spent a cumulative ~180 hours breastfeeding and another 139 hours pumping milk, which has given me a lot of time to wonder about… breastfeeding.
